title: bursera hindsiana var. rhoifolia
intro: Bursera hindsiana var. rhoifolia, commonly known as Mexican copal, is a plant species that belongs to the Burseraceae family. It has been traditionally used in Mexican folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiparasitic properties, which may aid in treating various ailments such as skin infections, wounds, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Mexican copal are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including terpenoids, flavonoids, and other compounds that exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of Bursera hindsiana var. rhoifolia have been reported to include triterpenoids, diterpenoids, and other phytochemicals that may contribute to its medicinal properties.
